name: Taqueria El Rorro
tagline: Tacos, gorditas and enchiladas on South Market Street.
about: Taqueria El Rorro is at 904 S Market St in Brenham and is a member of the Washington County Chamber of Commerce.
Diners describe generous portions, fair prices and a bright, cheerful dining room.

reviews.name: A Wanderlog reviewer
reviews.text: The portions were huge, the price was extremely competitive, and the service was wonderful!
